responsibility: Shared machine-description layer for LoongArch SIMD support across both LSX and LASX. It defines the common vector mode iterators, mode attributes, generic expanders, and reusable RTL pattern templates for integer and floating vector operations, then includes lsx.md and lasx.md so both extensions share one abstraction layer for instruction naming, widening/narrowing forms, reductions, and cross-extension code generation structure.
